summary: Build practical sales enablement and sales operations skills with CRM, dashboards, playbooks, and ramp-up tools. Train with TrainingCred.
lede: Sales enablement and sales operations give professionals who support sales teams a structured way to improve execution and reporting. The training covers building role-based onboarding and sales playbooks, setting lead qualification rules, and using CRM data and dashboards to monitor pipeline health and prepare forecast reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support sales execution, manage sales data, or build the systems that help sellers perform consistently. It fits both operational specialists and commercial leaders who need practical sales enablement and sales operations capability.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of sales processes, sales pipeline stages, and basic CRM usage. Prior experience in sales enablement, sales operations, sales management, or commercial support is helpful, but no coding or programming is required. Familiarity with reporting tools, spreadsheet analysis, and common sales metrics such as conversion rate, quota attainment, and pipeline coverage will make the exercises easier to apply.
